* **DataPrepAgent:**

* **ModellingAgent:**
  • Evaluate model choice and assumptions (e.g., Poisson, Negative Binomial)
  • Assess model fit and residual analysis
  • Check for overfitting and underfitting
  • Evaluate model interpretability and explainability
  • Compare model performance metrics (e.g., MAE, MSE, AIC)
